title: AML Agent Definition
description: Compiled JSON payload for an AML agent definition (.agent.md). Validates that the compiled output conforms to the AML v1.2 specification.

spec_version.title: Spec Version
spec_version.description: AML format version. Must be a platform-approved version string. The runtime rejects unknown spec versions. Describes the definition format, not the agent's behavior version.

agent_id.title: Agent ID
agent_id.description: Stable, immutable identifier for the agent lineage. Lowercase kebab-case or snake_case. Cannot change once any version is published.

version.title: Version
version.description: Semantic version of this definition. Increment on every published change. Patch for wording; minor for backward-compatible behavior; major for breaking schema or tool-access changes.

status.title: Status
status.description: Lifecycle state. draft=not runnable in production; active=runnable; deprecated=still runnable but hidden for new use; disabled=cannot be run.

meta.title: Metadata
meta.description: Business metadata for agent discovery, routing, and governance.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable display name for this agent.

category.title: Category
category.description: Classification category from a platform-controlled vocabulary (e.g., support, finance, hr). Not compiler-validated.

description.title: Description
description.description: One to two sentences describing the agent's purpose and behavior.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Team or individual responsible for this agent.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Searchable labels for discovery and filtering.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: Model and execution settings for this agent.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model identifier. Must resolve to a registered .model.md file. Unresolvable IDs or references to disabled models are hard compile errors.

fallback_model.title: Fallback Model
fallback_model.description: Model to use if the primary model is unavailable.

reasoning_effort.title: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: Editorial hint mapped to model-specific parameters. low for simple extraction; medium for standard tasks; high for complex multi-step reasoning.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0.0–1.0). Lower values produce more deterministic outputs. Values above 0.7 for business-critical workflows trigger a lint warning.

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Hard timeout in seconds for a single run.

max_input_chars.title: Max Input Characters
max_input_chars.description: Maximum allowed input size in characters.

max_output_tokens.title: Max Output Tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Maximum allowed output size in tokens.

max_turns.title: Max Turns
max_turns.description: Maximum number of conversation turns for loop-based agents.

max_tool_calls.title: Max Tool Calls
max_tool_calls.description: Maximum tool calls permitted per run across all tools.

backoff_seconds.title: Backoff Seconds
backoff_seconds.description: Seconds to wait between retry attempts.

interface.title: Interface
interface.description: Input and output contract for this agent.

input.title: Input
input.description: Input contract for this agent. Defines the expected shape of data the agent receives.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: JSON Schema object describing the agent's input. The top-level type should almost always be object.

examples.title: Examples
examples.description: Example input objects for documentation and testing.

output.title: Output
output.description: Output contract for this agent. Defines the shape of data the agent returns.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: JSON Schema object describing the agent's output. Runtime validates every response against this schema.

render.title: Render
render.description: Output rendering hints for the platform UI.

format.title: Format
format.description: Target rendering format for the agent's output.

citations_required.title: Citations Required
citations_required.description: If true, the agent must include source citations in its output.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tool access configuration. refs lists allowed tools; tool_choice controls whether the model must, may, or cannot call tools.

tool_choice.title: Tool Choice
tool_choice.description: none=tools advertised but model forbidden from calling them; auto=model decides; required=model must invoke at least one tool.

refs.title: References
refs.description: List of tool references. Each must resolve to a registered .tool.md file. Agent-level overrides can only tighten registry defaults.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.description: Knowledge base access configuration. Strongly recommended for any agent making factual claims about mutable information.

refs.title: References
refs.description: List of knowledge base references. Each must resolve to a registered .kb.md file.

retrieval.title: Retrieval
retrieval.description: Agent-level retrieval policy applied to all KB refs unless overridden per ref.

search_mode.title: Search Mode
search_mode.description: Retrieval strategy: keyword=BM25-style; semantic=vector similarity; hybrid=combined.

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Condition that triggers retrieval. Use 'auto' for model-driven retrieval.

max_chunks.title: Max Chunks
max_chunks.description: Maximum number of retrieved chunks injected into context.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum token budget allocated to retrieved context.

grounding_required.title: Grounding Required
grounding_required.description: If true, the agent must ground its responses in retrieved content.

citations_required.title: Citations Required
citations_required.description: If true, the agent must include citations for retrieved content.

use_when.title: Use When
use_when.description: Conditions under which the agent should retrieve from knowledge bases.

avoid_when.title: Avoid When
avoid_when.description: Conditions under which the agent should not retrieve from knowledge bases.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Longer-lived memory policy. References named external storage collections that persist beyond a single run.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Maximum scope of collections this agent may access: none=no memory; session=current conversation only; project=all sessions under same project; user=all sessions across all projects for same user.

read_collections.title: Read Collections
read_collections.description: Collection IDs this agent may read from. Each must resolve to a registered .collection.md file.

write_collections.title: Write Collections
write_collections.description: Collection IDs this agent may write to. Write behavior is governed by the collection's writeback configuration.

state.title: State
state.description: Session-local working state configuration. Describes short-term scratchpad behavior, not persistent shared storage.

session_history.title: Session History
session_history.description: ephemeral=conversation history discarded after each turn; session=history accumulated across all turns for the session.

working_state.title: Working State
working_state.description: ephemeral=intermediate state (tool results, partial outputs) discarded after each turn; session=preserved across turns.

scratchpad_visible_to_model.title: Scratchpad Visible To Model
scratchpad_visible_to_model.description: If true, accumulated working_state is injected into the model's context on subsequent turns.

max_state_tokens.title: Max State Tokens
max_state_tokens.description: Cap on total tokens allocated to state (history + working state) per turn. Older entries are trimmed when exceeded.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.description: Storage and retention configuration for run artifacts.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether artifact storage is enabled for this agent.

save_input.title: Save Input
save_input.description: Whether to persist raw user inputs. Disable if inputs may contain PII.

save_intermediate.title: Save Intermediate
save_intermediate.description: Whether to persist intermediate results and tool call outputs.

retention_class.title: Retention Class
retention_class.description: standard=default platform retention; extended=longer retention; ephemeral=deleted after run; restricted=access-controlled storage.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Runtime safety and compliance policies for this agent.

pii_redaction.title: PII Redaction
pii_redaction.description: If true, PII detected in inputs and outputs is automatically redacted before storage.

allow_external_http.title: Allow External HTTP
allow_external_http.description: If true, the agent is permitted to make outbound HTTP calls via action tools.

require_human_approval.title: Require Human Approval
require_human_approval.description: If true, a human must approve the agent's response before it is delivered to the caller.

blocked_content.title: Blocked Content
blocked_content.description: List of content categories this agent is prohibited from generating or processing.

allowed_connectors.title: Allowed Connectors
allowed_connectors.description: Allowlist of connector identifiers this agent may use.

data_residency.title: Data Residency
data_residency.description: Data residency constraint (e.g., 'eu', 'us'). Enforced by the platform at deploy time.

audit_level.title: Audit Level
audit_level.description: none=no audit logging; standard=inputs and outputs logged; full=all intermediate steps including tool calls logged.

role.title: Role
role.description: IAM role this agent assumes at runtime. Must resolve to a registered .iam.md file.

guardrails.title: Guardrails
guardrails.description: Guardrail checks applied at different positions in the agent pipeline.

input.title: Input
input.description: Guardrail checks applied to the agent's input before it reaches the model.

tool_input.title: Tool Input
tool_input.description: Guardrail checks applied to tool call arguments generated by the model, before dispatch. Primary use: detecting injected instructions or data exfiltration attempts.

tool_output.title: Tool Output
tool_output.description: Guardrail checks applied to tool results returned to the runtime, before the model processes them. Primary use: detecting indirect prompt injection via retrieved content.

output.title: Output
output.description: Guardrail checks applied to the agent's output before it is returned to the caller.

tool_calls.title: Tool Calls
tool_calls.description: Guardrail policies applied to tool calls.

require_user_confirmation_for.title: Require User Confirmation For
require_user_confirmation_for.description: List of tool IDs that require explicit user confirmation before the call is made.

block_tools_on_input_fail.title: Block Tools On Input Fail
block_tools_on_input_fail.description: If true, all tool calls are blocked when an input guardrail check fails.

ui.title: UI
ui.description: Platform UI configuration for the agent directory and input form.

icon.title: Icon
icon.description: Icon identifier or URL for this agent in the platform UI.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the agent directory.

short_description.title: Short Description
short_description.description: One-line description (max 120 characters) shown in the agent directory listing.

order.title: Order
order.description: Display order in the agent directory. Lower numbers appear first.

featured.title: Featured
featured.description: If true, this agent is highlighted in the featured section of the directory.

ui_hints.title: UI Hints
ui_hints.description: Per-field rendering hints for the agent's input form. Keys must match top-level property names in input.schema.

supported_locales.title: Supported Locales
supported_locales.description: List of BCP 47 locale codes supported by this agent.

default_locale.title: Default Locale
default_locale.description: Default locale used when no locale is specified by the caller.

localized_ui.title: Localized UI
localized_ui.description: Per-locale overrides for display_name, short_description, and ui_hints. Keyed by locale code.

orchestration.title: Orchestration
orchestration.description: Multi-agent orchestration configuration. Defines delegation, invocation, and topology settings.

can_delegate.title: Can Delegate
can_delegate.description: If true, this agent may delegate sub-tasks to other agents.

allowed_delegates.title: Allowed Delegates
allowed_delegates.description: List of agent IDs this agent is permitted to delegate to.

can_be_invoked_as_tool.title: Can Be Invoked As Tool
can_be_invoked_as_tool.description: If true, this agent may be invoked by other orchestrating agents as a tool.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.description: Escalation rules triggered by specific events (e.g., guardrail failure, model decision, timeout).

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: Multi-agent orchestration topology. One of: graph (directed node-edge), swarm (handoff-based), or workflow (task-dependency).

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Observability configuration for distributed tracing, metrics, and log capture.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Structured system prompt compiled from the Markdown body sections of the .agent.md file. Each section becomes a discrete field validated by the schema.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Compiled from the '# Purpose' section. One short paragraph describing what the agent is for, who uses it, and in what context.

behaviour.title: Behaviour
behaviour.description: Compiled from the '# System behavior' section. Core instruction block: tone, tool-use logic, reasoning approach, and what a good response looks like.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Compiled from the '# Rules' section. Non-negotiable constraints, one statement per item, written to be auditable by reviewers.

escalation.title: Escalation
escalation.description: Compiled from the optional '# Escalation' section. Conditions under which the agent should refuse, hand off, or request human review.

examples.title: Examples
examples.description: Compiled from the optional '# Examples' section. Few-shot examples or representative input/output pairs.

non_goals.title: Non Goals
non_goals.description: Compiled from the optional '# Non-goals' section. What the agent explicitly does not do.

output_style.title: Output Style
output_style.description: Compiled from the optional '# Output style notes' section. Human-facing rendering guidance for responses.

aml_id.title: AML ID
aml_id.description: Stable, immutable AML identifier. Lowercase kebab-case or snake_case.

json_schema_object.title: JSON Schema Object
json_schema_object.description: A valid AML JSON Schema subset (draft-07). The top-level type should be 'object'. $ref, $id, definitions, and recursive schemas are not supported.

tool_ref_entry.title: Tool Reference Entry
tool_ref_entry.description: A reference to a registered tool with optional agent-level overrides. Overrides can only tighten registry defaults.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Tool ID. Must resolve to a registered .tool.md file.

approval_required.title: Approval Required
approval_required.description: If true, human approval is required before this tool is called by this agent.

max_calls_per_run.title: Max Calls Per Run
max_calls_per_run.description: Maximum calls to this tool per run. Must not exceed the tool's registry default.

kb_ref_entry.title: KB Reference Entry
kb_ref_entry.description: A reference to a registered knowledge base with optional agent-level retrieval overrides.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: KB ID. Must resolve to a registered .kb.md file.

required.title: Required
required.description: If true, this KB is injected directly into the model context on every run regardless of retrieval trigger.

citations_required.title: Citations Required
citations_required.description: If true, the agent must cite content retrieved from this KB.

max_chunks.title: Max Chunks
max_chunks.description: Maximum chunks retrieved from this KB. Overrides the KB registry default.

max_tokens.title: Max Tokens
max_tokens.description: Maximum token budget for retrieved content from this KB.

min_score.title: Min Score
min_score.description: Minimum relevance score threshold (0.0–1.0) for chunks to be included.

guardrail_ref_entry.title: Guardrail Reference Entry
guardrail_ref_entry.description: A reference to a registered guardrail check with failure handling policy. Valid at all four positions: input, tool_input, tool_output, output.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Guardrail ID. Must resolve to a registered .guardrail.md file.

severity_threshold.title: Severity Threshold
severity_threshold.description: Required for score guardrails. Trigger on_fail if the returned severity is >= this value (0-10).

on_fail.title: On Fail
on_fail.description: Action taken when the guardrail check fails. Valid values depend on the referenced guardrail's behaviour.result_type. score: block|warn|log|escalate. transform: apply|reject. annotate/enrich: skip|fail_closed.

ui_hint_entry.title: UI Hint Entry
ui_hint_entry.description: Rendering hint for a single input field in the agent's UI form.

widget.title: Widget
widget.description: UI widget type to render for this input field.

label.title: Label
label.description: Display label for this field in the UI form.

placeholder.title: Placeholder
placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown inside the input before the user types.

helper_text.title: Helper Text
helper_text.description: Explanatory text shown below the input to guide the user.

options.title: Options
options.description: Selectable options for radio or select widgets.

value.title: Value
value.description: The option value submitted to the agent.

label.title: Label
label.description: The option label shown to the user.

accept.title: Accept
accept.description: Accepted MIME types or file extensions for file widgets (e.g., 'image/png', '.pdf').

max_size_mb.title: Max Size MB
max_size_mb.description: Maximum allowed file size in megabytes for file widgets.

escalation_rule.title: Escalation Rule
escalation_rule.description: An escalation rule that triggers routing to a human queue or another agent when a specific event occurs.

on.title: On
on.description: Event that triggers this escalation rule.

guardrail.title: Guardrail
guardrail.description: Guardrail ID that triggers this rule. Only relevant when on=guardrail.

node.title: Node
node.description: Node ID that triggers this rule. Only relevant when on=node_failure.

orchestration_graph.title: Orchestration Graph
orchestration_graph.description: Directed graph orchestration topology. Agents are nodes; transitions are edges with optional conditions.

execution_timeout.title: Execution Timeout
execution_timeout.description: Maximum total execution time in seconds for the graph.

max_node_executions.title: Max Node Executions
max_node_executions.description: Maximum total number of node executions across the graph to prevent infinite loops.

node_timeout.title: Node Timeout
node_timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds for a single node.

reset_on_revisit.title: Reset On Revisit
reset_on_revisit.description: If true, a node's state is reset when it is visited more than once.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: List of agent nodes in the graph.

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique node identifier within this graph.

condition.title: Condition
condition.description: Optional condition expression that must evaluate to true for this edge to be taken.

orchestration_swarm.title: Orchestration Swarm
orchestration_swarm.description: Swarm orchestration topology. Agents hand off control to each other dynamically until a terminal condition is reached.

max_handoffs.title: Max Handoffs
max_handoffs.description: Maximum total number of agent handoffs allowed.

max_iterations.title: Max Iterations
max_iterations.description: Maximum total iterations across all agents.

execution_timeout.title: Execution Timeout
execution_timeout.description: Maximum total execution time in seconds for the swarm.

node_timeout.title: Node Timeout
node_timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds for a single agent turn.

repetitive_handoff_detection_window.title: Repetitive Handoff Detection Window
repetitive_handoff_detection_window.description: Number of recent handoffs to inspect when detecting repetitive cycles.

repetitive_handoff_min_unique_agents.title: Repetitive Handoff Min Unique Agents
repetitive_handoff_min_unique_agents.description: Minimum number of unique agents required in the detection window to avoid a cycle error.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: List of agents participating in this swarm.

ref.title: Reference
ref.description: Agent ID participating in this swarm.

orchestration_workflow.title: Orchestration Workflow
orchestration_workflow.description: Workflow orchestration topology. Agents execute tasks in dependency order, with optional parallelism.

max_workers.title: Max Workers
max_workers.description: Maximum number of tasks that may execute concurrently.

retry_failed_tasks.title: Retry Failed Tasks
retry_failed_tasks.description: If true, failed tasks are retried before the workflow is marked failed.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Ordered list of tasks in this workflow.

task_id.title: Task ID
task_id.description: Unique identifier for this task within the workflow.

agent_ref.title: Agent Reference
agent_ref.description: Agent ID that executes this task.

description.title: Description
description.description: Human-readable description of what this task does.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Execution priority. Lower numbers run first when multiple tasks are ready.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description: List of task_ids that must complete before this task starts.

observability_auth.title: Observability Authentication
observability_auth.description: Authentication configuration for the observability exporter endpoint.

type.title: Type
type.description: Authentication scheme: none=no auth; bearer=Bearer token; mtls=mutual TLS.

credentials_ref.title: Credentials Reference
credentials_ref.description: Reference to a secret that holds the credentials for this auth scheme.

observability_signal.title: Observability Signal
observability_signal.description: Distributed tracing signal configuration (e.g., for spans exported via OTLP).

exporter.title: Exporter
exporter.description: Export destination: otlp=OpenTelemetry collector; console=stdout; none=disabled.

include_model_inputs.title: Include Model Inputs
include_model_inputs.description: If true, model input content is included in spans.

include_model_outputs.title: Include Model Outputs
include_model_outputs.description: If true, model output content is included in spans.

include_tool_args.title: Include Tool Args
include_tool_args.description: full=all tool arguments included; redacted=arguments masked; none=excluded.

include_tool_results.title: Include Tool Results
include_tool_results.description: full=all tool results included; redacted=results masked; none=excluded.

include_kb_chunks.title: Include KB Chunks
include_kb_chunks.description: If true, retrieved knowledge base chunks are included in spans.

propagate_context.title: Propagate Context
propagate_context.description: If true, W3C trace context is propagated to downstream tool and KB calls.

exporter.title: Exporter
exporter.description: Export destination: otlp=OpenTelemetry collector; console=stdout; none=disabled.

export_interval_seconds.title: Export Interval Seconds
export_interval_seconds.description: How often metrics are flushed to the exporter.

retention_days.title: Retention Days
retention_days.description: How many days metric data is retained on the platform.

custom_dimensions.title: Custom Dimensions
custom_dimensions.description: Additional dimension keys attached to every metric point.

exporter.title: Exporter
exporter.description: Export destination: otlp=OpenTelemetry collector; console=stdout; none=disabled.

level.title: Level
level.description: Minimum log level to capture and export.

structured.title: Structured
structured.description: If true, logs are emitted as structured JSON rather than plain text.

include_trace_context.title: Include Trace Context
include_trace_context.description: If true, trace and span IDs are injected into each log record for correlation.
